source.note: D3FEND inferred mappings based on shared digital artifacts. A mapping is not a verified mitigation or evidence of effectiveness.

AccessModeling.name: Access Modeling
AccessModeling.description: Access modeling captures and records the access permissions granted to identities (e.g., administrators, users, groups, systems) and optionally includes details on how these identities are stored, managed, and shared across systems.

AccountLocking.name: Account Locking
AccountLocking.description: The process of temporarily disabling user accounts on a system or domain.

AdministrativeNetworkActivityAnalysis.name: Administrative Network Activity Analysis
AdministrativeNetworkActivityAnalysis.description: Detection of unauthorized use of administrative network protocols by analyzing network activity against a baseline.

AgentAuthentication.name: Agent Authentication
AgentAuthentication.description: Agent authentication is the process of verifying the identities of agents to ensure they are authorized and trustworthy participants within a system.

Application-basedProcessIsolation.name: Application-based Process Isolation
Application-basedProcessIsolation.description: Application code which prevents its own subroutines from accessing intra-process / internal memory space.

ApplicationConfigurationHardening.name: Application Configuration Hardening
ApplicationConfigurationHardening.description: Modifying an application's configuration to reduce its attack surface.

ApplicationExceptionMonitoring.name: Application Exception Monitoring
ApplicationExceptionMonitoring.description: Monitoring the failures of system counters and timers.

ApplicationProtocolCommandAnalysis.name: Application Protocol Command Analysis
ApplicationProtocolCommandAnalysis.description: Analyzing application protocol level remote commands to detect unauthorized activity.

AssetVulnerabilityEnumeration.name: Asset Vulnerability Enumeration
AssetVulnerabilityEnumeration.description: Asset vulnerability enumeration enriches inventory items with knowledge identifying their vulnerabilities.

AuthenticationCacheInvalidation.name: Authentication Cache Invalidation
AuthenticationCacheInvalidation.description: Removing tokens or credentials from an authentication cache to prevent further user associated account accesses.

BootloaderAuthentication.name: Bootloader Authentication
BootloaderAuthentication.description: Cryptographically authenticating the bootloader software before system boot.

Certificate-basedAuthentication.name: Certificate-based Authentication
Certificate-basedAuthentication.description: Requiring a digital certificate in order to authenticate a user.

CertificateAnalysis.name: Certificate Analysis
CertificateAnalysis.description: Analyzing Public Key Infrastructure certificates to detect if they have been misconfigured or spoofed using both network traffic, certificate fields and third-party logs.

CertificatePinning.name: Certificate Pinning
CertificatePinning.description: Persisting either a server's X.509 certificate or their public key and comparing that to server's presented identity to allow for greater client confidence in the remote server's identity for SSL connections.

CertificateRotation.name: Certificate Rotation
CertificateRotation.description: Certificate rotation involves replacing digital certificates and their private keys to maintain cryptographic integrity and trust, mitigating key compromise risks and ensuring continuous secure communications.

ChangeDefaultPassword.name: Change Default Password
ChangeDefaultPassword.description: Changing the default password means replacing the factory-set credentials with a strong, unique password before the device is deployed, preventing unauthorized access.

Client-serverPayloadProfiling.name: Client-server Payload Profiling
Client-serverPayloadProfiling.description: Comparing client-server request and response payloads to a baseline profile to identify outliers.

ConfigurationInventory.name: Configuration Inventory
ConfigurationInventory.description: Configuration inventory identifies and records the configuration of software and hardware and their components throughout the organization.

ConnectionAttemptAnalysis.name: Connection Attempt Analysis
ConnectionAttemptAnalysis.description: Analyzing failed connections in a network to detect unauthorized activity.

ContainerImageAnalysis.name: Container Image Analysis
ContainerImageAnalysis.description: Analyzing a Container Image with respect to a set of policies.

ContentFiltering.name: Content Filtering
ContentFiltering.description: Content Filtering techniques aid in the process of analyzing an input file for malicious or erroneous content and outputting a sanitized version.

ContentModification.name: Content Modification
ContentModification.description: Modify content that does not comply with policy.

ContentQuarantine.name: Content Quarantine
ContentQuarantine.description: Transfer content that does not comply with policy to a quarantine zone.

CredentialCompromiseScopeAnalysis.name: Credential Compromise Scope Analysis
CredentialCompromiseScopeAnalysis.description: Determining which credentials may have been compromised by analyzing the user logon history of a particular system.

CredentialHardening.name: Credential Hardening
CredentialHardening.description: Credential Hardening techniques modify system or network properties in order to protect system or network/domain credentials.

CredentialRevocation.name: Credential Revocation
CredentialRevocation.description: Deleting a set of credentials permanently to prevent them from being used to authenticate.

CredentialRotation.name: Credential Rotation
CredentialRotation.description: Credential rotation is a security procedure in which authentication credentials, such as passwords, API keys, or certificates, are regularly changed or replaced to minimize the risk of unauthorized access.

CredentialScrubbing.name: Credential Scrubbing
CredentialScrubbing.description: The systematic removal of hard-coded credentials from source code to prevent accidental exposure and unauthorized access.

CredentialTransmissionScoping.name: Credential Transmission Scoping
CredentialTransmissionScoping.description: Limiting the transmission of a credential to a scoped set of relying parties.

DataInventory.name: Data Inventory
DataInventory.description: Data inventorying identifies and records the schemas, formats, volumes, and locations of data stored and used on the organization's architecture.

DecoyEnvironment.name: Decoy Environment
DecoyEnvironment.description: A Decoy Environment comprises hosts and networks for the purposes of deceiving an attacker.

DecoyFile.name: Decoy File
DecoyFile.description: A file created for the purposes of deceiving an adversary.

DecoyNetworkResource.name: Decoy Network Resource
DecoyNetworkResource.description: Deploying a network resource for the purposes of deceiving an adversary.

DecoyUserCredential.name: Decoy User Credential
DecoyUserCredential.description: A Credential created for the purpose of deceiving an adversary.

DisableRemoteAccess.name: Disable Remote Access
DisableRemoteAccess.description: Limiting access to a computing device which is not required through or from a non-organization-controlled network.

DiskEncryption.name: Disk Encryption
DiskEncryption.description: Encrypting a hard disk partition to prevent cleartext access to a file system.

DiskErasure.name: Disk Erasure
DiskErasure.description: Disk Erasure is the process of securely deleting all data on a disk to ensure that it cannot be recovered by any means.

DiskFormatting.name: Disk Formatting
DiskFormatting.description: Disk Formatting is the process of preparing a data storage device, such as a hard drive, solid-state drive, or USB flash drive, for initial use.

DiskPartitioning.name: Disk Partitioning
DiskPartitioning.description: Disk Partitioning is the process of dividing a disk into multiple distinct sections, known as partitions.

DNSAllowlisting.name: DNS Allowlisting
DNSAllowlisting.description: Permitting only approved domains and their subdomains to be resolved.

DNSDenylisting.name: DNS Denylisting
DNSDenylisting.description: Blocking DNS Network Traffic based on criteria such as IP address, domain name, or DNS query type.

DNSTrafficAnalysis.name: DNS Traffic Analysis
DNSTrafficAnalysis.description: Analysis of domain name metadata, including name and DNS records, to determine whether the domain is likely to resolve to an undesirable host.

DomainAccountMonitoring.name: Domain Account Monitoring
DomainAccountMonitoring.description: Monitoring the existence of or changes to Domain User Accounts.

DomainLogicValidation.name: Domain Logic Validation
DomainLogicValidation.description: Validation of variable state in the context of the domain application.

DomainTrustPolicy.name: Domain Trust Policy
DomainTrustPolicy.description: Restricting inter-domain trust by modifying domain configuration.

DynamicAnalysis.name: Dynamic Analysis
DynamicAnalysis.description: Executing or opening a file in a synthetic "sandbox" environment to determine if the file is a malicious program or if the file exploits another program such as a document reader.

EmailFiltering.name: Email Filtering
EmailFiltering.description: Filtering incoming email traffic based on specific criteria.

EmailRemoval.name: Email Removal
EmailRemoval.description: The email removal technique deletes email files from system storage.

EmulatedFileAnalysis.name: Emulated File Analysis
EmulatedFileAnalysis.description: Emulating instructions in a file looking for specific patterns.

EndpointHealthBeacon.name: Endpoint Health Beacon
EndpointHealthBeacon.description: Monitoring the security status of an endpoint by sending periodic messages with health status, where absence of a response may indicate that the endpoint has been compromised.

ExecutableAllowlisting.name: Executable Allowlisting
ExecutableAllowlisting.description: Using a digital signature to authenticate a file before opening.

ExecutableDenylisting.name: Executable Denylisting
ExecutableDenylisting.description: Blocking the execution of files on a host in accordance with defined application policy rules.

FileAnalysis.name: File Analysis
FileAnalysis.description: File Analysis is an analytic process to determine a file's status. For example: virus, trojan, benign, malicious, trusted, unauthorized, sensitive, etc.

FileCarving.name: File Carving
FileCarving.description: Identifying and extracting files from network application protocols through the use of network stream reassembly software.

FileCreationAnalysis.name: File Creation Analysis
FileCreationAnalysis.description: Analyzing the properties of file create system call invocations.

FileEncryption.name: File Encryption
FileEncryption.description: Encrypting a file using a cryptographic key.

FileEviction.name: File Eviction
FileEviction.description: File eviction techniques delete files from system storage.

FileFormatVerification.name: File Format Verification
FileFormatVerification.description: Verifying that a file conforms to its expected format specifications

FileIntegrityMonitoring.name: File Integrity Monitoring
FileIntegrityMonitoring.description: Detecting any suspicious changes to files in a computer system.

FirmwareBehaviorAnalysis.name: Firmware Behavior Analysis
FirmwareBehaviorAnalysis.description: Analyzing the behavior of embedded code in firmware and looking for anomalous behavior and suspicious activity.

FirmwareEmbeddedMonitoringCode.name: Firmware Embedded Monitoring Code
FirmwareEmbeddedMonitoringCode.description: Monitoring code is injected into firmware for integrity monitoring of firmware and firmware data.

ForwardResolutionDomainDenylisting.name: Forward Resolution Domain Denylisting
ForwardResolutionDomainDenylisting.description: Blocking a lookup based on the query's domain name value.

Hardware-basedProcessIsolation.name: Hardware-based Process Isolation
Hardware-basedProcessIsolation.description: Preventing one process from writing to the memory space of another process through hardware based address manager implementations.

Hardware-basedWriteProtection.name: Hardware-based Write Protection
Hardware-basedWriteProtection.description: Physical methods of preventing data from being written to computer storage.

HardwareComponentInventory.name: Hardware Component Inventory
HardwareComponentInventory.description: Hardware component inventorying identifies and records the hardware items in the organization's architecture.

HomoglyphDetection.name: Homoglyph Detection
HomoglyphDetection.description: Comparing strings using a variety of techniques to determine if a deceptive or malicious string is being presented to a user.

HostReboot.name: Host Reboot
HostReboot.description: Initiating a host's reboot sequence to terminate all running processes.

HostShutdown.name: Host Shutdown
HostShutdown.description: Initiating a host's shutdown sequence to terminate all running processes.

IdentifierActivityAnalysis.name: Identifier Activity Analysis
IdentifierActivityAnalysis.description: Taking known malicious identifiers and determining if they are present in a system.

InboundSessionVolumeAnalysis.name: Inbound Session Volume Analysis
InboundSessionVolumeAnalysis.description: Analyzing inbound network session or connection attempt volume.

InboundTrafficFiltering.name: Inbound Traffic Filtering
InboundTrafficFiltering.description: Restricting network traffic originating from untrusted networks destined towards a private host or enclave.

InputDeviceAnalysis.name: Input Device Analysis
InputDeviceAnalysis.description: Operating system level mechanisms to prevent abusive input device exploitation.

IOPortRestriction.name: IO Port Restriction
IOPortRestriction.description: Limiting access to computer input/output (IO) ports to restrict unauthorized devices.

IPCTrafficAnalysis.name: IPC Traffic Analysis
IPCTrafficAnalysis.description: Analyzing standard inter process communication (IPC) protocols to detect deviations from normal protocol activity.

Kernel-basedProcessIsolation.name: Kernel-based Process Isolation
Kernel-basedProcessIsolation.description: Using kernel-level capabilities to isolate processes.

LocalAccountMonitoring.name: Local Account Monitoring
LocalAccountMonitoring.description: Analyzing local user accounts to detect unauthorized activity.

LocalFilePermissions.name: Local File Permissions
LocalFilePermissions.description: Local file permissions is the systematic process of defining, implementing, and managing access control policies that dictate user permissions for accessing files on a local system through the configuration of operating system functionality.

LogicalLinkMapping.name: Logical Link Mapping
LogicalLinkMapping.description: Logical link mapping creates a model of existing or previous node-to-node connections using network-layer data or metadata.

MemoryBoundaryTracking.name: Memory Boundary Tracking
MemoryBoundaryTracking.description: Analyzing a call stack for return addresses which point to unexpected memory locations.

Multi-factorAuthentication.name: Multi-factor Authentication
Multi-factorAuthentication.description: Requiring proof of two or more pieces of evidence in order to authenticate a user.

NetworkNodeInventory.name: Network Node Inventory
NetworkNodeInventory.description: Network node inventorying identifies and records all the network nodes (hosts, routers, switches, firewalls, etc.) in the organization's architecture.

NetworkResourceAccessMediation.name: Network Resource Access Mediation
NetworkResourceAccessMediation.description: Control of access to organizational systems and services by users or processes over a network.

NetworkTrafficCommunityDeviation.name: Network Traffic Community Deviation
NetworkTrafficCommunityDeviation.description: Establishing baseline communities of network hosts and identifying statistically divergent inter-community communication.

NetworkTrafficFiltering.name: Network Traffic Filtering
NetworkTrafficFiltering.description: Restricting network traffic originating from any location.

NetworkTrafficPolicyMapping.name: Network Traffic Policy Mapping
NetworkTrafficPolicyMapping.description: Network traffic policy mapping identifies and models the allowed pathways of data at the network, transport, and/or application levels.

NetworkTrafficSignatureAnalysis.name: Network Traffic Signature Analysis
NetworkTrafficSignatureAnalysis.description: Analyzing network traffic and compares it to known signatures

One-timePassword.name: One-time Password
One-timePassword.description: A one-time password is valid for only one user authentication.

OperationalProcessMonitoring.name: Operational Process Monitoring
OperationalProcessMonitoring.description: Monitoring physical parameters and operator actions related to an operational environment.

OutboundTrafficFiltering.name: Outbound Traffic Filtering
OutboundTrafficFiltering.description: Restricting network traffic originating from a private host or enclave destined towards untrusted networks.

PasswordAuthentication.name: Password Authentication
PasswordAuthentication.description: Password authentication is a security mechanism used to verify the identity of a user or entity attempting to access a system or resource by requiring the input of a secret string of characters, known as a password, that is associated with the user or entity.

PasswordRotation.name: Password Rotation
PasswordRotation.description: Password rotation is a security policy that mandates the periodic change of user account passwords to mitigate the risk of unauthorized access due to compromised credentials.

PerHostDownload-UploadRatioAnalysis.name: Per Host Download-Upload Ratio Analysis
PerHostDownload-UploadRatioAnalysis.description: Detecting anomalies that indicate malicious activity by comparing the amount of data downloaded versus data uploaded by a host.

PhysicalLinkMapping.name: Physical Link Mapping
PhysicalLinkMapping.description: Physical link mapping identifies and models the link connectivity of the network devices within a physical network.

ProcessCodeSegmentVerification.name: Process Code Segment Verification
ProcessCodeSegmentVerification.description: Comparing the "text" or "code" memory segments to a source of truth.

ProcessLineageAnalysis.name: Process Lineage Analysis
ProcessLineageAnalysis.description: Identification of suspicious processes executing on an end-point device by examining the ancestry and siblings of a process, and the associated metadata of each node on the tree, such as process execution, duration, and order relative to siblings and ancestors.

ProcessSegmentExecutionPrevention.name: Process Segment Execution Prevention
ProcessSegmentExecutionPrevention.description: Preventing execution of any address in a memory region other than the code segment.

ProcessSelf-ModificationDetection.name: Process Self-Modification Detection
ProcessSelf-ModificationDetection.description: Detects processes that modify, change, or replace their own code at runtime.

ProcessSpawnAnalysis.name: Process Spawn Analysis
ProcessSpawnAnalysis.description: Analyzing spawn arguments or attributes of a process to detect processes that are unauthorized.

ProcessSuspension.name: Process Suspension
ProcessSuspension.description: Suspending a running process on a computer system.

ProcessTermination.name: Process Termination
ProcessTermination.description: Terminating a running application process on a computer system.

ProtocolMetadataAnomalyDetection.name: Protocol Metadata Anomaly Detection
ProtocolMetadataAnomalyDetection.description: Collecting network communication protocol metadata and identifying statistical outliers.

RadiationHardening.name: Radiation Hardening
RadiationHardening.description: Radiation hardening is the process of making electronic components and circuits resistant to damage or malfunction caused by high levels of ionizing radiation.

ReissueCredential.name: Reissue Credential
ReissueCredential.description: Issue a new credential to a user which supersedes their old credential.

RelayPatternAnalysis.name: Relay Pattern Analysis
RelayPatternAnalysis.description: The detection of an internal host relaying traffic between the internal network and the external network.

RemoteFileAccessMediation.name: Remote File Access Mediation
RemoteFileAccessMediation.description: Remote file access mediation is the process of managing and securing access to file systems over a network to ensure that only authorized users or processes can interact with remote files.

RemoteTerminalSessionDetection.name: Remote Terminal Session Detection
RemoteTerminalSessionDetection.description: Detection of an unauthorized remote live terminal console session by examining network traffic to a network host.

RestoreDatabase.name: Restore Database
RestoreDatabase.description: Restoring the data in a database.

RestoreEmail.name: Restore Email
RestoreEmail.description: Restoring an email for an entity to access.

RestoreFile.name: Restore File
RestoreFile.description: Restoring a file for an entity to access.

RestoreNetworkAccess.name: Restore Network Access
RestoreNetworkAccess.description: Restoring a entity's access to a computer network.

RestoreUserAccountAccess.name: Restore User Account Access
RestoreUserAccountAccess.description: Restoring a user account's access to resources.

ReverseResolutionIPDenylisting.name: Reverse Resolution IP Denylisting
ReverseResolutionIPDenylisting.description: Blocking a reverse lookup based on the query's IP address value.

RPCTrafficAnalysis.name: RPC Traffic Analysis
RPCTrafficAnalysis.description: Monitoring the activity of remote procedure calls in communication traffic to establish standard protocol operations and potential attacker activities.

ScheduledJobAnalysis.name: Scheduled Job Analysis
ScheduledJobAnalysis.description: Analysis of source files, processes, destination files, or destination servers associated with a scheduled job to detect unauthorized use of job scheduling.

SegmentAddressOffsetRandomization.name: Segment Address Offset Randomization
SegmentAddressOffsetRandomization.description: Randomizing the base (start) address of one or more segments of memory during the initialization of a process.

SenderMTAReputationAnalysis.name: Sender MTA Reputation Analysis
SenderMTAReputationAnalysis.description: Characterizing the reputation of mail transfer agents (MTA) to determine the security risk in emails.

SenderReputationAnalysis.name: Sender Reputation Analysis
SenderReputationAnalysis.description: Ascertaining sender reputation based on information associated with a message (e.g. email/instant messaging).

ServiceBinaryVerification.name: Service Binary Verification
ServiceBinaryVerification.description: Analyzing changes in service binary files by comparing to a source of truth.

SessionTermination.name: Session Termination
SessionTermination.description: Forcefully end all active sessions associated with compromised accounts or devices.

ShadowStackComparisons.name: Shadow Stack Comparisons
ShadowStackComparisons.description: Comparing a call stack in system memory with a shadow call stack maintained by the processor to determine unauthorized shellcode activity.

SoftwareInventory.name: Software Inventory
SoftwareInventory.description: Software inventorying identifies and records the software items in the organization's architecture.

SoftwareUpdate.name: Software Update
SoftwareUpdate.description: Replacing old software on a computer system component.

StackFrameCanaryValidation.name: Stack Frame Canary Validation
StackFrameCanaryValidation.description: Comparing a value stored in a stack frame with a known good value in order to prevent or detect a memory segment overwrite.

StrongPasswordPolicy.name: Strong Password Policy
StrongPasswordPolicy.description: Modifying system configuration to increase password strength.

SystemCallAnalysis.name: System Call Analysis
SystemCallAnalysis.description: Analyzing system calls to determine whether a process is exhibiting unauthorized behavior.

SystemCallFiltering.name: System Call Filtering
SystemCallFiltering.description: Controlling access to local computer system resources with kernel-level capabilities.

SystemConfigurationPermissions.name: System Configuration Permissions
SystemConfigurationPermissions.description: Restricting system configuration modifications to a specific user or group of users.

SystemDaemonMonitoring.name: System Daemon Monitoring
SystemDaemonMonitoring.description: Tracking changes to the state or configuration of critical system level processes.

SystemFileAnalysis.name: System File Analysis
SystemFileAnalysis.description: Monitoring system files such as authentication databases, configuration files, system logs, and system executables for modification or tampering.

SystemFirmwareVerification.name: System Firmware Verification
SystemFirmwareVerification.description: Cryptographically verifying installed system firmware integrity.

SystemInitConfigAnalysis.name: System Init Config Analysis
SystemInitConfigAnalysis.description: Analysis of any system process startup configuration.

SystemVulnerabilityAssessment.name: System Vulnerability Assessment
SystemVulnerabilityAssessment.description: System vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a system's components in the context of their configuration and internal dependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the system's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual component vulnerabilities.

Token-basedAuthentication.name: Token-based Authentication
Token-basedAuthentication.description: Token-based authentication is an authentication protocol where users verify their identity in exchange for a unique access token. Users can then access the website, application, or resource for the life of the token without having to re-enter their credentials.

TokenBinding.name: Token Binding
TokenBinding.description: Token binding is a security mechanism used to enhance the protection of tokens, such as cookies or OAuth tokens, by binding them to a specific connection.

TrustedLibrary.name: Trusted Library
TrustedLibrary.description: A trusted library is a collection of pre-verified and secure code modules or components that are used within software applications to perform specific functions. These libraries are considered reliable and have been vetted for security vulnerabilities, ensuring they do not introduce risks into the application.

UnlockAccount.name: Unlock Account
UnlockAccount.description: Restoring a user account's access to resources by unlocking a locked User Account.

URLAnalysis.name: URL Analysis
URLAnalysis.description: Determining if a URL is benign or malicious by analyzing the URL or its components.

URLReputationAnalysis.name: URL Reputation Analysis
URLReputationAnalysis.description: Analyzing the reputation of a URL.

UserAccountPermissions.name: User Account Permissions
UserAccountPermissions.description: Restricting a user account's access to resources.

UserGeolocationLogonPatternAnalysis.name: User Geolocation Logon Pattern Analysis
UserGeolocationLogonPatternAnalysis.description: Monitoring geolocation data of user logon attempts and comparing it to a baseline user behavior profile to identify anomalies in logon location.

UserSessionInitConfigAnalysis.name: User Session Init Config Analysis
UserSessionInitConfigAnalysis.description: Analyzing modifications to user session config files such as .bashrc or .bash_profile.

VariableInitialization.name: Variable Initialization
VariableInitialization.description: Setting variables to a known value before use.

VideoSurveillance.name: Video Surveillance
VideoSurveillance.description: Monitoring of physical areas via camera video feeds to deter, detect, and investigate unauthorized access and related security events.

WebSessionAccessMediation.name: Web Session Access Mediation
WebSessionAccessMediation.description: Web session access mediation secures user sessions in web applications by employing robust authentication and integrity validation, along with adaptive threat mitigation techniques, to ensure that access to web resources is authorized and protected from session-related attacks.
